answer: Each epoch auctions 400 answer slots by uniform price: sealed burn bids, top 400 win, each winner pays the 401st-highest bid, burned. A fleet must win many slots, but the clearing price equals the marginal bid below the cutoff, posted by its own extra identities: each added sybil bids up the bill its winners share, and at the zenith of expansion the burn per slot tops the 2.5-token payout, so marginal sybils lose. The ivory objection, collusive 1-token bids, fails: honest bidders capture the slots a fleet needs. Bids hide under an epoch cipher until cutoff.
